free_tier.stated: 6 TB HDD, 3 vCPU, 4 GB RAM, 10,000 GB bandwidth, dedicated IP. Free for 60 days. Only 3 units existed.

retention.stated: until the instance is recycled; not persistent

egress.terms: Includes 10 TB per month transfer. Bandwidth is metered beyond the allowance and Cloudflare proxying is not provided.

record.tooling: Root KVM. SSH/SFTP/rsync, so rclone sftp or a local fuse mount works. No object API.
record.chaining: Not repeatable. Explicitly 'non-renewable, and the VPS will be deleted at the end of the 60-day period', 3 slots, application via a Google Form, and the thread closed with 'Filled!' within days. This is a marketing gesture, not a capacity source.
record.reliability_note: Deliberately ephemeral: the data is destroyed at day 60 by design. Good for one 6 TB cold-archive burst, worthless as standing storage.

evidence.proved: 'DISK SPACE: 6 TB (HDD) … completely free for 60 days'; 'there are only 3 Storage VPS servers available'; 'This free offer is non-renewable, and the VPS will be deleted at the end of the 60-day period.'
